description: Geometric search and collision detection tools: bounding box trees, point ownership, and GJK distance computation.

classes.name: BoundingBoxTree
classes.description: Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) tree for efficient geometric search. Create using bb_tree().

properties.name: num_bboxes
properties.description: Number of bounding boxes in the tree.

methods.name: get_bbox
methods.description: Return bounding box i as pair of corner points.

methods.name: create_global_tree
methods.description: Create a global bounding box tree (one box per process).

classes.name: PointOwnershipData
classes.description: Data structure for determining point ownership across processes.

functions.name: bb_tree
functions.description: Create a bounding box tree for mesh entities of a given dimension.

functions.name: compute_collisions_points
functions.description: Compute collisions between a bounding box tree and points.

functions.name: compute_collisions_trees
functions.description: Compute collisions between two bounding box trees.

functions.name: compute_closest_entity
functions.description: Compute the closest mesh entity to a point.

functions.name: compute_distance_gjk
functions.description: Compute distance between convex bodies p and q using GJK algorithm.

functions.name: squared_distance
functions.description: Compute squared distances from points to mesh entities.

functions.name: determine_point_ownership
functions.description: Determine which process owns given points.

functions.name: create_midpoint_tree
functions.description: Create a bounding box tree for entity midpoints.
